flags.text: EdgeDesk’s own sources disagree on sack rate allowed (Nebraska); the evidence uses the corroborated figures, and any model term built on the play-by-play figure may be off.

The availability report lists Dante Moore out, and EdgeDesk’s main model subtracts a generic quarterback absence (3.9 points) from Oregon — it does not price the replacement’s own play (Dylan Raiola: 66.1% completions, 8.1 yards per attempt, 5 TD, 2 INT).
EdgeDesk’s published number sits 4.0 points from the middle of its own other models.

EdgeDesk’s game page already labels this gap a DATA FAULT: EdgeDesk’s number and the market are further apart than any real disagreement explains, which is a signal about EdgeDesk’s data, not about the game.
